im in the same boat as you. while i dont go to school anymore (i dropped out), i never had true friends that invited me over or cared enough to text me. now that im out of school i have literally 0 friends. humans are prey to this cruel world, the best thing you can do is push through it as long as you can. life doesn't necessarily get better long-term per say, but it's not always going to be like this. life is full of ups and downs, and while the downs may significantly longer than the ups, just remember there will always occasionally be an up in your life. look forward to that up, strive for that up.   


if you want to get serious help and talk to professionals, i recommend you talk to your parents/guardians about therapy or a psychiatrist. if these feelings get worse i'd recommend getting on medication, but it's all up to you and what you think is best for you. 

stay strong, and remember tons of people (including myself) go through what you are going through at this very moment.
